topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: You ever walk into a place, and it's just like slipping on an old coat? I ain't talking about the comfort; I'm talking about the weight. Saw a sign today, said "Last Orders." My favorite spot, closing up. They said times are tough, but it's more than that. People stop caring, or they get too busy to care. Same as they do about each other. I've seen good folks lose everything, watch their faces change. It gets you thinking, maybe you should've spent more time here, kept the place busy, made a difference. But you didn’t. Now you're just another face that’ll have to find somewhere else to eat. Doesn’t feel right, but what can you do? Maybe it’s time to start figuring things out.
